name: Fossil Hominid Sites of South Africa
description: Scattered across Gauteng, Limpopo and North West provinces, these limestone cave systems, including Sterkfontein near Johannesburg, hold the world's richest concentration of early human ancestor remains. Here a child's skull found at Taung in 1924 and the 2.3-million-year-old "Mrs. Ples" reshaped our picture of human origins. Makapan Valley's caves also preserve signs of early fire use.
